# DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolution

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolutionInspection`

Calling an instance (non-static) method through `::` (`self::run()`,
`static::run()`, `$obj::run()`) hides that the call is really an instance call
and breaks in static contexts. Such calls should use `->`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{16,22,23,24,40} [Before]
<?php

class Engine
{
    public function start() {}
}

class Car extends Engine
{
    public function start() {}
    public function honk() {}
    public static function build() {}

    public static function factory()
    {
        self::honk();
        self::build();
    }

    public function drive($speed)
    {
        static::honk();
        Car::start();
        self::honk();
        parent::start();
        $cb = function () { self::honk(); };
    }
}

class SportsCar extends Car
{
    public function start()
    {
        Car::start();
        Engine::start();
    }
}

$car = new Car();
$car::honk();
$car::build();
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

class Engine
{
    public function start() {}
}

class Car extends Engine
{
    public function start() {}
    public function honk() {}
    public static function build() {}

    public static function factory()
    {
        self::honk();
        self::build();
    }

    public function drive($speed)
    {
        $this->honk();
        $this->start();
        $this->honk();
        parent::start();
        $cb = function () { self::honk(); };
    }
}

class SportsCar extends Car
{
    public function start()
    {
        Car::start();
        Engine::start();
    }
}

$car = new Car();
$car->honk();
$car::build();
```

:::

<li>line 22: Call &#39;honk&#39; with &#39;$this-&gt;&#39; instead of &#39;::&#39;.</li>
<li>line 23: Call &#39;start&#39; with &#39;$this-&gt;&#39; instead of &#39;::&#39;.</li>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolution": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolution

/**
 * @noinspection DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolutionInspection
 */
```
